depth_targets.title: Static website configuration (main page suffix / 404 page)
depth_targets.current_reason: The website config round-trips through buckets.patch exactly as a client sets it, but Vyomi does not run the separate public per-bucket static-website HTTP host (storage.googleapis.com website serving) — the suffix object and 404 page are never actually served.

depth_targets.title: Requester Pays billing
depth_targets.current_reason: The billing.requesterPays flag round-trips through buckets.patch exactly as a client sets it, but Vyomi has no billing account or distinct "requester" identity separate from the bucket owner to charge — access is never actually billed to a requester.

depth_targets.title: Object versioning (noncurrent object versions)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi's GCS core keeps only the latest generation of an object; it has no store for noncurrent versions, so turning on versioning cannot preserve, list or restore older generations.

depth_targets.title: Soft delete policy (for data recovery)
depth_targets.current_reason: Soft delete restores a deleted/overwritten object from its prior generation within a retention window; it depends on the same noncurrent-version history Vyomi does not keep (see gcp.storage.versioning), so a deleted object cannot be recovered.

depth_targets.title: Hierarchical namespace (HNS buckets with true folders)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi's GCS core models every bucket as a flat key-value namespace (folders are zero-byte "name/" placeholder objects); it has no HNS bucket mode with atomic folder rename/delete and folder-level IAM.

depth_targets.title: Resource tags (GCP-wide tag bindings, distinct from labels)
depth_targets.current_reason: Tags are bindings against Resource Manager's separate Tags API (tagKeys/tagValues); Vyomi's GCS core has no integration with that service, so tags can't be attached to a bucket.

depth_targets.title: Security insights (bucket column) and Advisor recommendations
depth_targets.current_reason: Both are produced by IAM Recommender / Security Command Center analysis and usage-pattern ML over real production traffic; Vyomi runs no such analysis, so it has no findings or recommendations to show.
depth_targets.hint: telemetry: emit real metrics/logs from the simulated engine (wave-6 Prometheus/OTel are the offline sinks once landed; until then derive real series from actual API activity in the core) — never synthetic random data

depth_targets.title: Monitoring (Cloud Monitoring charts: request/error rates, bandwidth)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi does not meter per-request traffic over time, so it has no time-series data to chart for request counts, error rates or bandwidth — including the Time range selector and the "Filter by: All locations" control, which have nothing to filter.

depth_targets.title: Inventory reports (per-bucket Storage Insights object inventory, CSV/Parquet to a destination bucket)
depth_targets.current_reason: Inventory reports are a separate Storage Insights sub-product (distinct from gcp.storage.insights-datasets' project-level dataset configs); Vyomi has no report generator to run on a schedule and write CSV/Parquet output to a destination bucket.

depth_targets.title: Object enrichments (Smart Storage — Document AI classification/extraction on upload)
depth_targets.current_reason: Enrichments run Document AI (and other Vertex AI pipelines) against newly uploaded objects; Vyomi has no ML inference engine to classify or extract from object content.
